login_user: login to the Hugging Face Hub with a token and optionally add it as git credential
logout_user: logout from the Hugging Face Hub by deleting saved tokens and clearing git credentials
switch_active_token: switch to a different stored access token by name and set it as active
list_stored_tokens: list all stored access tokens with masked values and indicate the current active token
notebook_login: display a notebook widget to log in to the Hugging Face Hub with a password input and login button
